f14456c42023af0d.description: Job Title: Senior Specialist Compliance and Governance Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia Company Overview Riyadh Cables Group is the leading manufacturer of electrical wires and cables in the MENA region, offering innovative power transmission and communication solutions that fuel sustainable development. Our commitment to environmentally responsible practices and cutting-edge technology drives progress across infrastructure, energy, and industrial sectors. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity in our workforce with a dynamic environment that encourages growth, innovation, and sustainability. Roles and Responsibilities: Supporting the implementation and continuous improvement of the Compliance and Corporate Governance framework across the company. Responsible for monitoring compliance with applicable laws, regulations, policies, and internal controls, supporting governance activities, identifying compliance gaps, and preparing reports and recommendations to strengthen the company’s compliance and governance practices. The role supports the company’s obligations as a public joint-stock company listed on Tadawul and regulated by the CMA, in line with the CMA Corporate Governance Regulations and leading control frameworks such as the COSO Internal Control – Integrated Framework. Required Educational Level: Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Corporate Governance, or equivalent. Preferred professional certifications include Certified Compliance Officer; Certificate in Governance, Risk & Compliance; Certified Compliance & Ethics Professional (CCEP); Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS); a recognized Corporate Governance / Board Secretary certification; CIA, or equivalent. Required Experience: 3–5 years of experience in compliance, corporate governance, internal controls, or equivalent. Experience within a publicly listed (Tadawul / CMA-regulated) joint-stock company environment is strongly preferred. Experience in manufacturing, industrial, energy, or infrastructure companies is preferred. Experience with a Big 4 firm or another reputable governance, compliance, or risk advisory consultancy firm is preferred.

f136754f16c24c42.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ساس البلد للتشغيل والصيانة عن أخصائي علوم نبات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إجراء الأبحاث والدراسات المتعمقة حول الحياة النباتية، وتطوير المفاهيم والنظريات التشغيلية، والمساهمة في التطبيق العملي لنتائج الأبحاث في مجالات الزراعة والبيئة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الأبحاث حول الحياة النباتية، بما في ذلك تربية المحاصيل والنباتات الزراعية وإنتاجها ومردودها وإدارتها. تطوير المفاهيم والنظريات والمناهج التشغيلية في مجال علوم النبات. تصميم وإجراء التجارب على النباتات، واختبار الفرضيات في كل من المختبر والميدان. تفسير البيانات والنتائج باستخدام النماذج والتقنيات الرياضية. تطبيق النظريات والتقنيات للمساهمة في مجالات مثل الزراعة والبيئة. إعداد الأوراق والتقارير العلمية، ونشر الأبحاث في الدورات الأكاديمية، وعرض النتائج في المؤتمرات المهنية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال علوم النبات أو مجال ذي صلة. معرفة قوية بمبادئ البحث العلمي وتصميم التجارب. القدرة على تحليل البيانات وتفسيرها باستخدام الأدوات الإحصائية والرياضية. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير العلمية والعروض التقديمية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر هذا الدور في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية، وهو وظيفة بدوام كامل تتطلب الالتزام بإجراء الأبحاث الميدانية والمخبرية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا كأخصائي علوم نبات، يرجى تقديم طلبكم عبر المنصة المخصصة.

Liaise with internal departments, external stakeholders, and third-party providers to monitor progress and ensure deadlines and deliverables are met. Support the establishment of new healthcare facilities, coordinating operational requirements, contracts, banking arrangements, and administrative activities. Monitor project timelines, track outstanding actions, and maintain accountability across all stakeholders. Proactively follow up on tasks, resolve coordination challenges, and escalate delays where necessary. Collaborate with local teams to support project delivery, operational readiness, and successful handovers. Provide hands-on operational support and assist with additional business activities as required. Manage competing priorities effectively while maintaining attention to detail and ownership of assigned responsibilities. Support international development initiatives and undertake overseas travel when required. f15cb0d53f7f2b73.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة الشريك التقني لتقنية المعلومات عن مدخل بيانات للانضمام إلى فريقها في ضرما، الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان دقة واكتمال البيانات المدخلة والمخزنة، مع الالتزام بالمعايير المهنية لسرية المعلومات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراجعة استمارات البيانات وترميزها والتأكد من اكتمال جميع المعلومات المطلوبة. إدخال البيانات والمعلومات بدقة في أنظمة الحاسب الآلي المخصصة، وفقاً للبرامج والنظم الإحصائية المعتمدة. مراجعة رموز التصنيف للبيانات والمعلومات المدخلة وتصحيح أي أخطاء محتملة لضمان الدقة. تخزين المعلومات المدخلة بطريقة منظمة وآمنة. إجراء النسخ الاحتياطية اللازمة للبيانات والمعلومات المخزنة بشكل دوري. الالتزام الصارم بالتعليمات والسياسات المتعلقة بسرية البيانات والمعلومات وحمايتها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إدخال البيانات أو ما يعادله. القدرة على مراجعة وتدقيق البيانات بدقة عالية. مهارات جيدة في استخدام الحاسب الآلي وبرامج إدخال البيانات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة ضرما، الرياض. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بالعمل ضمن فريق لضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

f16729a0ecf064cc.description: About KEO International Consultants KEO International Consultants is a creative enterprise known for its innovative approach to planning, design, and project delivery in both built and natural environments. With over 57 years of experience, KEO provides end-to-end services, contributing to significant projects globally. The firm is recognized by ENR in the Top 225 International Design Firms and Top 20 International PM/CM Firms, and by World Architecture as the 50th largest global architecture firm and #1 in the Middle East Region in their 2021 WAS 100 Survey. The Opportunity: Civil Inspector KEO International Consultants is seeking a Civil Inspector to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires 8-10 years of experience and focuses on ensuring the quality and compliance of civil and architectural finishing works on various projects. Key Responsibilities Inspect and monitor civil, architectural, and finishing works to ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications, project requirements, and KEO standards. Conduct regular site inspections to verify the quality, workmanship, and progress of architectural and civil works. Inspect architectural finishes, including flooring, tiling, wall finishes, ceilings, painting, plastering, joinery, doors, windows, waterproofing, and other internal and external finishes. Monitor civil works, including blockwork, plastering, screed, waterproofing, concrete-related works, and other associated building works. Review approved shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, inspection and test plans, and other technical documentation. Ensure construction activities are carried out in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, approved materials, and applicable standards. Identify defects, non-conformances, and workmanship issues, ensuring corrective actions are properly implemented and closed out. Witness inspections and testing activities in accordance with approved Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs). Coordinate with contractors, consultants, and other disciplines to resolve technical and construction-related issues. Review and comment on RFIs, shop drawings, material submissions, and other relevant technical documentation. Monitor the quality and progress of civil and architectural finishing works, reporting concerns to the project team. Ensure proper coordination between architectural finishes, civil, structural, MEP, and other building services. Maintain accurate records of inspections, observations, non-conformances, and site activities. Participate in site meetings, inspections, snagging, rectification, and handover activities. Inspect completed works during the snagging and handover stages to ensure all outstanding works and defects are properly addressed. Ensure that works comply with applicable Saudi Arabian regulations, project specifications, approved drawings, and relevant international standards. Support the project team in maintaining the required quality standards throughout the construction process. Ensure compliance with project health, safety, and environmental requirements during site activities. Qualifications and Experience Proven experience on building, residential, commercial, hospitality, or mixed-use projects. Strong hands-on experience inspecting architectural finishes and civil works. Good knowledge of construction materials, finishing systems, workmanship standards, and inspection procedures. Experience reviewing shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, ITPs, RFIs, and technical documentation. Strong understanding of architectural finishing works, including flooring, tiling, ceilings, painting, plastering, joinery, doors, windows, waterproofing, and external works. Experience working within a consultancy or PMC environment is highly desirable. Good knowledge of Saudi Arabian construction practices, standards, and authority requirements. Strong ability to identify defects and non-compliance and follow through on corrective actions. Excellent communication, coordination, reporting, and site inspection skills. Relevant professional certifications would be an advantage. Saudi Arabia/GCC experience is highly desirable. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply for this Civil Inspector position in Riyadh. The salary for this role will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

f18325d9accfea1b.description: Own the health, security, and continuity of the organisation's core Microsoft platform: Exchange Server 2019 (on-premises) in hybrid with Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS/DHCP, and the identity and email-security layers that sit on top of them. The role helps maintain reliable corporate messaging, mailbox availability, and identity services in a multi-site business environment. KEY Responsibilities Core: Microsoft Exchange (on-premises + hybrid) • Install, configure, administer, and upgrade Microsoft Exchange Server 2019 on-premises; apply cumulative updates and security patches on a controlled schedule. • Run and maintain Exchange Hybrid with Microsoft 365: hybrid configuration, free/busy, cross-premises mail flow, and directory synchronisation health. • Execute mailbox migrations (on-prem to/from Exchange Online) with zero-data-loss cutovers and a tested rollback for each wave. • Manage mailbox lifecycle, distribution and shared mailboxes, mail flow, transport rules, send/receive connectors, and certificate lifecycle (issuance, renewal, binding) with no lapsed-certificate outages. • Design, build, and maintain Database Availability Groups (DAG) for Exchange high availability; own failover testing and quorum health. • Diagnose and resolve complex mail-delivery, queue, performance, and availability problems using message tracking, protocol logs, and transport diagnostics. Core: Active Directory & Group Policy • Perform advanced Active Directory administration: domain services, sites, trusts, OU design, delegation, user authentication, and permissions. • Design, implement, troubleshoot, and optimise Group Policy (GPO): scope, precedence, security filtering, and drift control. • Administer and maintain DNS and DHCP as authoritative infrastructure services for the estate. • Own AD replication health, security hardening (privileged accounts, tiering), and disaster-recovery readiness for the directory (backup, forest/domain recovery runbook, tested restore). Core: Email Security • Administer the enterprise email-security gateway/solution: anti-spam, anti-phishing, malware protection, content filtering, quarantine management, and policy tuning. • Own the sender-authentication stack (SPF, DKIM, and DMARC) from monitoring through enforcement, and manage mail routing and inbound/outbound threat protection. • Investigate email-borne threats and phishing incidents with Information Security; tune policies to cut false positives without opening exposure. Core: Networking & Security • Apply working command of TCP/IP, DNS, routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, VLANs, and NAT to keep messaging and identity reachable and secure. • Troubleshoot network-layer faults affecting mail flow, hybrid connectivity, and authentication end to end. • Apply network-security principles and integrate cleanly across messaging, identity, cloud, and the security stack. Core: Microsoft 365, Identity & Automation • Administer Microsoft 365, Entra ID (Azure AD), and Single Sign-On (SSO): tenant configuration, conditional access, and application registrations in coordination with Information Security. • Build and maintain PowerShell scripting and automation for provisioning, reporting, bulk operations, and repeatable runbooks. • Own monitoring, backup, disaster recovery, patching, and infrastructure documentation for the messaging and identity estate; keep runbooks and topology current. General • Provide senior-level escalation for messaging, identity, and email-security incidents raised by IT Team Leaders and the Service Desk. • Maintain up-to-date, formally registered technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and as-built diagrams. • Contribute to departmental KPI objectives set for the financial year. • Ensure IT policies, security standards, and change-management procedures are followed. • Perform other assignments as required. Business Continuity • Ensure the messaging and identity BC/DR plans adequately deliver the required recovery capability and meet business continuity requirements. • Maintain, test, and document DAG failover, AD recovery, and Exchange/M365 restore procedures on a periodic basis. • Communicate the implications of infrastructure changes that may impact the BCMS. • Participate in BC exercises; support the Business Impact Analysis for messaging and identity services. • Make recommendations, remove roadblocks, and report continuity risk to IT management. Working Arrangement (Onshore, Riyadh) • Base: Riyadh, with on-site and hybrid working arrangements in line with organisational policy. • Hours: Standard working hours, with flexibility to support business needs. • On-call: Participates in an on-call rotation for critical messaging, identity, and email-security incidents, including outside standard working hours, in line with agreed response targets. • Change windows: Executes major changes (upgrades, migrations, DAG/AD maintenance) inside approved maintenance windows, typically outside peak, with change-management sign-off. • Access & security: Follows applicable information security, data-handling, and privileged-access controls. Competencies: Professional and Technical Behavioral Competencies Competency Level Analytical Thinking Level 4 Initiative Level 3 Continuous Learning Level 3 Communication (written & verbal) Level 3 Stress Management Level 3 Planning & Organizing Level 3 Adaptability Level 3 Teamwork Level 3 Technical Competencies Competency Proficiency Microsoft Exchange Server 2019 (on-prem + hybrid, DAG) Expert Exchange migrations & mail flow / connectors / certificates Expert Active Directory & Group Policy (design, DR, replication) Expert DNS / DHCP / domain services Advanced Email security (gateway, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, anti-phishing) Advanced Microsoft 365 / Entra ID / SSO / Conditional Access Advanced PowerShell scripting & automation Advanced Networking & network security (TCP/IP, firewall, VPN, VLAN, NAT) Intermediate to Advanced Backup, DR, patching & infrastructure documentation Advanced Critical incident management Advanced Competencies: EHS Awareness of basic EHS requirements and corporate objectives; awareness of EHS/incident reporting within the QEHS management system. Organizational Competencies Intermediate. Refer to the organisation's applicable competency framework. Decision Making Decides and executes: messaging/identity configuration, patch and change execution within approved windows, migration cutover mechanics, GPO and email-security policy tuning, and automation design. Recommends and routes up: architecture changes, tenant-level identity/security policy, BC/DR strategy, and major-version platform decisions (to the relevant IT infrastructure and Information Security leadership). Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) • Maintain high availability of messaging services and prevent avoidable outages through timely certificate management and patching. • Respond to critical messaging and identity incidents within agreed targets, restore services promptly, and document root causes. • Mailbox migration waves delivered on schedule with zero data loss and a tested rollback per wave. • Keep systems patched in line with approved security baselines and remediate critical vulnerabilities within required timeframes. • Email security: SPF/DKIM/DMARC at enforcement; measured reduction in delivered phishing/spam with controlled false-positive rate. • Test business continuity and disaster recovery procedures periodically and document successful recovery tests. • Maintain current technical runbooks and infrastructure documentation for all owned services. • Meet the individual KPIs agreed for the current financial year. Level 3 Engineer of Microsoft Exchange 2019 and Exchange Server Subscription Edition. Have proven experience in installation and upgrade of Microsoft Exchange Environment-Expert. Hybrid environment Microsoft 365 ability to manage Microsoft Teams. Active Directory and understanding of Group Policies Qualification: E

f1761eacb9646e66.description: نبحث في شركة سهام الامن السيبراني عن محترف مبيعات وتطوير أعمال لديه خبرة فعلية في بيع خدمات أو حلول الأمن السيبراني للشركات (B2B) ، ويستطيع بناء علاقات مع أصحاب القرار، واكتشاف الفرص، وتحويلها إلى اجتماعات مؤهلة وعقود فعلية. ستعمل مع فريق فني متخصص وذي خبرة، مع توفر ملف تعريفي للشركة ومواد تسويقية وفنية تدعم عرض خدماتنا وإقناع العملاء. نبحث عن شخص مبادر يستطيع فتح أبواب جديدة للشركة، ولا يعتمد فقط على وصول العملاء أو طلبات عروض الأسعار. مسؤولياتك استقطاب عملاء جدد وبناء العلاقات: تحديد الشركات المستهدفة والوصول إلى مسؤولي الأمن السيبراني وتقنية المعلومات والمشتريات، من خلال الاتصالات والبريد والقنوات المهنية والزيارات الميدانية. ترتيب الاجتماعات وإدارتها: جدولة لقاءات مؤهلة مع أصحاب القرار، وزيارة الشركات في الرياض، وتقديم الشركة وخدماتها بصورة احترافية، حضوريًا وعن بُعد. فهم الاحتياج وتطوير الفرصة: التعرف على احتياجات العميل وتوقيت الشراء وآلية اتخاذ القرار، والتنسيق مع الفريق الفني لتحديد الخدمة المناسبة وإعداد العروض الفنية والمالية. متابعة الفرص وإغلاق الصفقات: إدارة دورة البيع من أول تواصل حتى التفاوض وإتمام التعاقد بالتنسيق مع الإدارة، ومتابعة طلبات العروض وإجراءات تأهيل الموردين المرتبطة بالفرص. تنظيم العمل وتحقيق النتائج: توثيق التواصل والفرص والخطوات التالية في سجل المبيعات، وتقديم تحديثات واضحة عن تقدم الصفقات والعمل على تحقيق الأهداف المتفق عليها. من نبحث عنه؟ لديه خبرة سابقة مثبتة في مبيعات الأمن السيبراني للشركات ، مع أمثلة عملية على دوره في استقطاب العملاء وإغلاق الصفقات. وتُعطى الأفضلية لمن سبق له بيع خدمات اختبار الاختراق والتقييمات الأمنية. يفهم طبيعة بيع الخدمات التقنية ودورات الشراء لدى الشركات، ويستطيع شرح القيمة التجارية لخدمات مثل اختبار الاختراق وتقييم الثغرات (VAPT)، وأمن التطبيقات وواجهات API، واختبارات الفريق الأحمر (Red Team) . لا يُشترط أن يكون مختبر اختراق، لكن يجب أن يفهم ما يبيعه. يمتلك مهارات قوية في التواصل والعرض والإقناع والتفاوض والمتابعة، ويجيد التواصل المهني بالعربية والإنجليزية. لديه معرفة بالسوق السعودي، ويُفضّل امتلاك شبكة علاقات مهنية مع الجهات المستهدفة، مع القدرة على العمل باستقلالية وتنظيم الزيارات والاجتماعات. مقيم في الرياض أو مستعد للعمل منها ، وقادر على زيارة العملاء والتواصل معهم ميدانيًا وعن بُعد. ما الذي ستجده لدينا؟ فريق فني خبير يدعم النقاشات الفنية وتحديد نطاق الخدمات، وملف تعريفي ومواد تساعدك في تقديم قدرات الشركة، وتعاون مباشر مع الإدارة لتطوير الفرص ومتابعة العروض والتفاوض. نبحث عن شريك فعلي في نمو المبيعات؛ شخص يستطيع الوصول إلى العميل المناسب، وبناء الثقة، وتحويل النقاش إلى فرصة تجارية ثم إلى تعاقد. عند التقديم يرجى إرفاق السيرة الذاتية مع نبذة مختصرة عن خبرتك في مبيعات الأمن السيبراني للشركات، وأنواع الخدمات التي سبق لك بيعها، ودورك في إغلاق الصفقات .

f1810173e50f16fb.description: Company Description Zyada Credit | زيادة الائتمانية is a fintech company built on three core pillars: high standards, speed, and ownership. The team applies institutional-grade credit discipline while operating faster than traditional financial institutions, ensuring decisions are structured, defensible, and scalable. Zyada focuses on removing friction rather than cutting corners, and promotes a culture where ownership means accountability for outcomes, not just tasks. The company is building a credit intelligence layer that enables lenders to make better, faster, and more consistent decisions across multiple loan types, offering talent the opportunity to work on impactful, data-driven products. Role Description The Product Specialist is a full-time hybrid role based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with flexibility for some work-from-home arrangements. This role focuses on understanding Zyada’s credit intelligence products in depth and serving as a key point of contact between product, sales, and customer service teams. Day-to-day responsibilities include supporting product demonstrations for lenders, gathering and analyzing customer feedback, and translating market needs into clear product requirements. The Product Specialist will assist in onboarding clients, provide ongoing product training and support, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to improve product features and user experience. The role also involves monitoring product performance, preparing reports, and contributing to go-to-market activities to ensure product adoption and customer satisfaction. Qualifications Product-focused skills: Experience in Product Specialist or similar customer-facing product roles, with the ability to deeply understand and explain financial or fintech products. Analytical skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, including comfort with data, metrics, and using insights to recommend product improvements. Communication skills: Clear and effective verbal and written communication, capable of presenting complex concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Customer service skills: Demonstrated ability to support clients, manage expectations, resolve issues, and maintain long-term relationships. Sales-related skills: Experience partnering with sales teams, supporting product demos, and contributing to pre- and post-sales activities. Additional qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Economics, or a related field; familiarity with credit, lending, or financial services; ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment; proficiency with productivity tools and basic data analysis; fluency in English, with Arabic language skills considered an advantage.

f10a5cf0d9ee9177.description: About Red Sea Global and Botanica Red Sea Global is seeking a Manager - Landscape Maintenance for Botanica, its subsidiary specializing in sustainable greenery. Botanica provides dedicated landscape services across Red Sea Global’s destinations, focusing on integrating new species with local flora. Since 2020, Botanica has cultivated over 5 million plants, with a target of 30 million by 2030, contributing to the natural landscapes of The Red Sea & Amaala. The company emphasizes a planet-first approach to sustainability, managing over 1 million square meters of landscape. Role Overview The Manager - Landscape Maintenance is responsible for overseeing and managing landscape maintenance operations across assigned sites. This role ensures high-quality landscape presentation, optimal plant health, efficient irrigation performance, operational efficiency, and compliance with HSE standards. The Manager leads Supervisors and field teams, manages resources, monitors operational performance, and coordinates with internal stakeholders and clients to ensure effective service delivery. This is a full-time position requiring 5-10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Manage daily landscape maintenance operations across assigned sites and areas. Develop weekly and monthly maintenance plans and ensure activities align with operational schedules and priorities. Lead and supervise Landscape Maintenance Supervisors, technical teams, gardeners, and field workforce. f1ee6922c2973607.description: Job Purpose The QHSSE Manager is responsible for overseeing all Quality, Health, Safety, Environmental & Security related aspects, within the complex/attractions. Monitor and review security systems and processes to identify potential vulnerabilities and implement corrective actions. f1db38297d9eb103.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أرض الأرائج للتجارة والاستيراد عن أخصائي إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى دعم الرئيس المباشر في تحقيق الأهداف الإدارية وتنفيذ المهام المتنوعة، مع التركيز على نقل المعرفة وإعداد التقارير المتخصصة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مساعدة الرئيس المباشر في تحديد الأهداف الرئيسية للإدارة أو القسم، والمساهمة في اقتراح وتطبيق الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات لتحقيقها. تقديم الدعم والمساندة لزملاء العمل الأقل خبرة داخل الفرع أو الإدارة، وضمان نقل الخبرات والمعارف اللازمة لتطوير أدائهم. تنفيذ العمليات الإدارية والإجرائية المختلفة لتلبية احتياجات الفرع أو الإدارة. تنفيذ المشروعات والمبادرات المتخصصة، وتوظيف المعارف والخبرات الفنية لضمان تحقيق أفضل النتائج. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة، والمشاركة في عرضها وتوضيحها، والعمل على حفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إداري ذي صلة. القدرة على أداء مجموعة متنوعة من المهام الإدارية. مهارات جيدة في إعداد الوثائق والتقارير. نوع الوظيفة وموقع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة جدة، بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.
